reason: I would let them do the free site visit, but I will not book a brand I have never heard of until I have Asian Paints and Berger quotes in hand to compare per square foot. Rs 89,000 is not small money for a name with no track record I can check.
objection: Turbolux is unknown to me, and my real problem is the damp patches on the outside walls. The guarantee only says bubbling and peeling, so if the damp comes back through the new paint after the next monsoon I am not sure they owe me anything.
would_change_my_mind: A written site-visit quote that beats the big-brand quotes per square foot, with damp treatment on the outside walls included and covered by the 3-year guarantee, plus a chance to see a Kochi house they painted at least one monsoon ago.
